description.narrative: Insatens övergripande mål är: "Contribute to an inclusive and sustainable development of the coffee value chain for enhanced incomes and improved nutrition status of smallholder farmers in Ruvuma, Mbeya and Songwe regions of Tanzania". Insatsens effektmål är följande: 1. Increased production and productivity of quality coffee by smallholder coffee producers through equitable, efficient resource allocations and SALM Practices. 2. Increased incomes from improved postharvest, processing capacities and market linkages (smallholder farmers, women and men, small and medium enterprises – SME’s) and financial services linkages. 3. Enhanced competitiveness of coffee value chain with supportive policy and regulatory framework.

We Effect har ansökt om finansiering av egeninsats om 8 255 550 SEK för EU-projektet "Smallholder Coffee Development Project (SCDP)" under åren 2020-2024 i Tanzania.
Insatsen syftar till att bidra till en inkluderande och hållbar utveckling av värdekedjan för kaffeproduktion för ökade inkomster och förbättrad näringsstatus för småskaliga kaffeodlare i Ruvuma-, Mbeya- och Songwe regionerna i Tanzania.
De förväntade effektmålen för insatsen är följande:
1. Increased production and productivity of quality coffee by smallholder coffee producers through equitable, efficient resource allocations and SALM Practices.
2. Increased incomes from improved postharvest, processing capacities and market linkages (smallholder farmers, women and men, small and medium enterprises – SME’s) and financial services linkages.
3. Enhanced competitiveness of coffee value chain with supportive policy and regulatory framework.
Insatsen har en total budget på 3 750 000 EUR, vilket motsvarar cirka 41 250 000 SEK. Sökt stöd från Sida är 8 255 550 SEK, vilket motsvarar cirka 20 procent av den totala budgeten.

We Effect has applied to Sida for funding of 8 255 550 SEK to carry out the EU project "Smallholder Coffee Development Project (SCDP)" during the period 2020-2024 in Tanzania.
The overall objective of the proposed action is to contribute to an inclusive and sustainable development of the coffee value chain for enhanced incomes and improved nutrition status of smallholder farmers in Ruvuma, Mbeya and Songwe regions of Tanzania.
The expected outcomes of the project are:
1. Increased production and productivity of quality coffee by smallholder coffee producers through equitable, efficient resource allocations and SALM Practices.
2. Increased incomes from improved postharvest, processing capacities and market linkages (smallholder farmers, women and men, small and medium enterprises – SME’s) and financial services linkages.
3. Enhanced competitiveness of coffee value chain with supportive policy and regulatory framework.
The contribution's total budget is 3 750 000 EUR, corresponding to approximately 41 250 000 SEK. The requested support from Sida is 8 255 550 SEK, which corresponds to approximately 20 per cent of the total budget.
